title: Toronto Centreline (TCL)
join_role: the base map: one row for each street section (50,027 of 64,392 street pieces; trails, rivers, railways and walkways taken out)
notes: Carries the street name, the kind of road, the one-way flag and the address ranges for both sides of every section. It does not carry the street's parking itself: no lane counts, no parking side, no space positions.

title: Traffic and Parking By-Law Schedules
geometry: None (text; 52.9% of kept rules carry one intersection anchor point)
join_role: the parking rules: 27,768 current street parking rules, put in a spreadsheet and counted per street name
notes: The schedules of the city's parking bylaw (Chapter 950). One data file of 806.5 MB holds all 77,940 rule records, current and repealed. Locations are legal text (street, side, between). Times are text ('Anytime', '7:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m., Mon. to Fri.'). No record carries map coordinates for the stretch a rule covers.

title: Parking Tickets
join_role: the tickets as written: 6,454,695 tickets (2023-2025), added up by street name and attached to every section of the street
notes: The ticket record is fully open. Tickets locate to a street address; the sister project put 86.9% of them on a map as address points.

title: On-Street Permit Parking Area Maps
join_role: permit parking: a section is in a permit area when its midpoint falls inside one of the 97 permit-area shapes
notes: Permit areas are shapes on a map with area codes (e.g. 12B). The file names the areas; permit rules (hours, prices) are not in it.

title: Bikeways
join_role: an older copy of the bike lane file, no longer updated: the record's refresh rate is 'Will not be Refreshed', and the file is not the same as Cycling Network (1,323 features vs 1,581, different section IDs). The maintained Cycling Network file was used instead
notes: Kept in the list because a search for the bike network returns both records and nothing states which one is official.

title: Cycling Network
join_role: bike lanes: on-road lines within 25 m of a street section with the same street name set the section's bike lane type (923 on-road features of 1,581)
notes: The maintained bike network record (updated twice a year, modified 2026-09-14). Off-road trails were left out because they do not occupy a parking lane.

title: Green P Parking
join_role: car parks: 252 car parks with address, capacity and price text; each street section counts the car parks within 250 m and the distance to the nearest
notes: The refresh rate on the city's open data site is 'Will not be Refreshed': the file used is the 2019 snapshot. Prices are text strings (e.g. '$2.50 / Half Hour'), not numbers with units. Off-street only.

title: Parking Occupancy
join_role: use layer: joined to Green P car parks by car park number (CP52 style); latest quarter kept
notes: Average daily peak occupancy per TPA off-street facility by quarter. Off-street only: there is no equivalent for on-street spaces.

title: Bike Share Toronto
join_role: 1,070 stations from the live station feed the record points to; each street section counts the stations within 250 m
notes: The entry on the city's open data site points to the live feed, not a file. Station capacity is in the feed.

title: CaféTO Locations
join_role: 287 of 1,636 locations are parking-lane cafés or parklets; each street section counts them within 250 m
notes: CaféTO locations record the season's licensed parking-lane and sidewalk cafés. The excerpt on the city's open data site calls them historical locations.

title: Off-Street Parking – Surface Lots – Accessible Stalls
join_role: 669 accessible spaces at TPA surface lots; each street section counts them within 250 m
notes: Space-by-space coordinates exist here, but only for accessible spaces in off-street surface lots. Source note says positions come from 2024 aerial photography.

title: Taxicab Stand Locations
join_role: February 2014 snapshot, no coordinates: street, side and a text location per stand. The current stands are in the by-law schedules (Schedule 05, 159 current rules), which were used instead
notes: 112 stands listed. The file is 12 years out of date relative to the by-law file.

title: The City Operated Electric Vehicle Charging Station Map
join_role: 82 city EV charging locations; each street section counts them within 250 m
notes: Most locations are in Green P facilities (off-street). The by-law schedules add 59 current EV-charging parking rules by street name.

title: Residential Front Yard Parking
join_role: licensed front-yard and boulevard parking pads are listed by address (about 0.8 MB CSV) with licensed space counts; no map shapes are published, and pads sit off the roadway
notes: Included because it is a parking permission the city sells; it describes the boulevard, not the parking lane.

title: Free Floating Carshare Program
join_role: the record has a single web resource and no downloadable file, so there is nothing to use; designated car-share parking areas exist as 48 current by-law rules (Schedule 43) and were included through the parking rules
notes: A programme description page standing in for a data file.

title: Sidewalk Inventory
join_role: shapefile-only resource (9.7 MB), listed for completeness; sidewalk presence borders the street parking but does not allocate it
notes: Says sidewalks are keyed to the city's street map, so a match is possible in future work.

title: Topographic Mapping – Edge of Road
join_role: the physical roadway extent as map shapes (244 MB GeoJSON); listed, not downloaded, because it adds pavement extent only, no street parking allocation
notes: Collected from aerial photography. This is the closest public layer to the edge of the street, and it still contains no parking information.

title: Topographic Mapping – Physical area of parking lots
join_role: map shapes of parking lot areas (155 MB GeoJSON); lot outlines without space lines, prices or operators
notes: Shows that lot areas are mapped from the air while the spaces inside them are not published.

title: Topographic Mapping – Physical area of sidewalks
join_role: sidewalk area shapes; same reasoning as edge-of-road

title: One Way Streets
join_role: duplicates the one-way flag already on every street section in the city's street map (ONEWAY_DIR_CODE_DESC), so it adds nothing

title: Intersection File - City of Toronto
join_role: the city's intersection points; the by-law rules point to these IDs in 52.9% of kept rules, but the point is not the stretch the rule covers

title: Road Restrictions
join_role: a live feed of current closures; it says what blocks a street today, but records are point-in-time and the feed is not archived as a data file
notes: Useful for operations; not a stable join source.

title: Street Furniture - Transit Shelter
join_role: transit shelters stand on the sidewalk or boulevard beside the parking lane; listed as street furniture, not used because shelters do not allocate the parking lane
notes: Part of a street furniture family (benches, litter bins, poster structures) published as separate data files.

title: Street Furniture - Bicycle Parking - Bicycle Locking Ring
join_role: bicycle locking rings in the right-of-way; same reasoning as transit shelters
notes: Replaced the retired bicycle post and ring file.

title: Bicycle Parking Racks
join_role: multi-bike racks; same reasoning as transit shelters

title: Bicycle Post and Ring Locations
join_role: retired file (notes say so); replaced by street furniture bicycle parking
notes: Kept in the list because a search for bicycle parking still returns it.

title: Parking Lot Facilities
join_role: Parks, Forestry and Recreation parking lots; the resource is a Q3 2016 spreadsheet, nine-plus years out of date

title: Private Transportation Companies - Summary and Trip Data
join_role: ride-hail trip aggregates show street parking demand (pickups and drop-offs), but trips are aggregated and the full files are yearly zips of 28-55 MB; inventoried as demand evidence
notes: Trip-level pickup points would describe street parking demand directly; the published sample is 1.3 MB.

title: Traffic Control Devices
join_role: devices are signals and related equipment, upcoming or recently activated only; it contains no parking signs
notes: Read carefully: this is the file a searcher expects to hold the sign list. It does not.

title: Traffic Signals Tabular
join_role: traffic signal, beacon and crossover locations; no parking signs

title: Turn Restrictions
join_role: retired in 2018 (notes say so); current turn rules live in the by-law schedules (Schedules 23 and 24)

title: 10 Year Cycling Network Plan – On-Street (2016)
join_role: the 2016 plan for on-street cycling routes; a plan, not the built network (bikeways carries the built network)

title: Solid Waste Daytime Curbside Collection Areas
join_role: daytime curbside collection areas; collection trucks occupy the parking lane on collection days, but the file gives areas, not days per street

title: Merged GTFS - TTC Routes and Schedules
join_role: TTC stops are street space allocations for transit; the GTFS zip carries stop points and schedules. Listed; matching at stop level is future work
notes: Bus loading zones also appear as 20 current by-law rules (Schedule 10) and 551 school bus loading rules (Schedule 37).
